_comment: What a vault is made of, in the one place both processes read it from.
electron/main.js requires this; src/vault-paths.js imports it and hands
the renderer the matchers built from it. A fact stated here once cannot
have the two sides disagreeing about it — which is what a note the tree
shows and the editor will not open comes down to.
languageFlagPattern is a source string rather than a literal because a
regular expression is not a JSON type; both readers build it with the `u`
flag, which is what makes the \u{...} escapes mean codepoints.
